ask: When the button is clicked, toggle the class "active" on it.
source: on click toggle .active on me

ask: When the button is clicked, put the text Saved into the element with id out.
source: on click put "Saved" into #out

ask: When the button is clicked, hide the element with id panel.
source: on click hide #panel

ask: When the button is clicked, add the class "open" to the element with id menu, then remove its class "closed".
source: on click add .open to #menu then remove .closed from #menu

ask: When the button is clicked, fetch /api/greeting and put the result into the element with id out.
source: on click fetch /api/greeting then put it into #out

ask: When the button is clicked: if it has the class "on", remove that class; otherwise add it.
source: on click if I match .on remove .on else add .on end

ask: When the button is clicked, append the text "x" to the element with id out three times.
source: on click repeat 3 times append "x" to #out end

ask: When the button is clicked, send a custom event named refresh to the element with id list, then add the class "sent" to the button.
source: on click send refresh to #list then add .sent to me

ask: When the button is clicked, set the variable $n to 5 and put it into the element with id out.
source: on click set $n to 5 then put $n into #out

ask: When the button is clicked, increase the variable $count by one and put it into the element with id out.
source: on click increment $count then put $count into #out

ask: Define a behavior named Hider that hides the element when it is clicked (the page installs it on the button with: install Hider).
source:
behavior Hider
  on click hide me end
end

ask: When the input receives input, put its value into the element with id out.
source: on input put my value into #out

ask: When the button is clicked, put the value of the input with id field into the element with id out.
source: on click put the value of #field into #out

ask: When the button is clicked, add the class "sel" to the first list item inside the element with id list.
source: on click add .sel to the first <li/> in #list

ask: When the button is clicked, set its attribute aria-expanded to "true".
source: on click set @aria-expanded to "true"

ask: When the button is clicked, put the text "x" at the end of the element with id out.
source: on click put "x" at end of #out

ask: When the button is clicked, for every element with the class "item", add the class "seen" to it.
source: on click for item in .item add .seen to item end

ask: When the button is clicked, if there is no element with class "item" inside the element with id list, put the text "empty" into the element with id out.
source: on click if no .item in #list put "empty" into #out end

ask: When the button is clicked, take the class "selected" from whichever element with class "tab" has it, and give it to the button.
source: on click take .selected from .tab for me

ask: When the button is clicked, remove the button.
source: on click remove me
